name: SQD
description:
SQD Portal lets Claude query indexed blockchain data through a hosted, read-only MCP server. It validates user intent, maps requests to Portal API queries, and returns structured results that are easy for Claude to inspect, summarize, and turn into tables or charts.

Users can discover supported networks, resolve tokens and contracts, inspect wallets, query transactions, logs, token transfers, Hyperliquid fills, Bitcoin activity, Solana instructions, and chain-level analytics without writing raw API calls.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SQD to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SQD to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://portal.sqd.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is SQD MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, SQD scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SQD MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SQD lists 28 MCP tools, including portal_bitcoin_get_analytics, portal_bitcoin_query_transactions, portal_debug_hyperliquid_query_replica_commands, portal_debug_query_blocks, portal_debug_resolve_time_to_block, portal_evm_get_analytics, portal_evm_get_contract_activity, portal_evm_get_contract_deployment, portal_evm_get_ohlc, portal_evm_query_logs, portal_evm_query_token_transfers, and portal_evm_query_transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SQD?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SQD in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SQD does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
SQD is developed by Subsquid Labs GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
